title: Week 6 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “credit report”?
options: Money deducted from pay and sent toward taxes or other obligations.
A record of credit accounts, payment history, balances, inquiries, and certain public information.
A card-network process through which a disputed transaction may be reversed under applicable rules.
Property pledged to secure a loan.
